4_native_fit_no_sysmem_spill.status: PASS at gate scope; NOT SETTLED for the full run -- see caveat
4_native_fit_no_sysmem_spill.evidence: 12-step probe at the exact epoch-2 config: 9.3 GiB allocated / 10.5 GiB reserved of 23.889 GiB physical; median 5.56 s/step.
4_native_fit_no_sysmem_spill.caveat: a short probe systematically under-predicts peak reserved. The epoch-1 gate probe reported 16.9 GiB and that run went on to reserve 24.6 GiB, marginally over the 23.889 GiB physical ceiling. Peak memory is a per-step property and epoch count does not change it, so ~24.6 GiB is expected again. The authoritative figure is the one printed at the end of the full training log, and it is reported there rather than claimed here.

deliberate_deviations_from_epoch_1.why: 1,902 steps over ~176 min on a host with 7 documented crash/interruption incidents. save_steps only controls checkpointing and provably does not alter training math, so tightening it is a pure recovery win: worst-case loss on a crash falls from ~46 min to ~23 min. Costs ~1.3 GB of 1.4 TB free.
